title: Mixed Event — Picture Perfect! — Episode3 Once We Know Each Other

meta.Episode: Episode3 — Once We Know Each Other
meta.Event Outline: When Kamiyama High School's very first Arts Festival is announced, Class 2-A decides to produce a film! It falls to Nene to sit in the director's chair, but will her leadership cut it?

rows.Line: After school
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (“Screenwriting For Dunces”, “Learn To Write Screenplays In Just 3 Days!” and “How To Start Writing Scripts Today!”)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Surprisingly, the school library had some useful books on the subject...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was hoping they might also have some actual scripts or screenplays, but beggars can't be choosers...)
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Aoyagi...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Are those references on screenwriting...?
We don't see those borrowed often.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, so... My class is gonna make a film for the arts festival.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which is why I need a crash course on how to come up with a story for one.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I was also looking for books that include actual scripts, though. I wanted some examples to help me come up with scenes and decide how to present them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
In that case...
Please wait here for just a moment.
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Aoyagi...?!
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Apologies for the wait.
I believe you were looking for these.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The screenplay for “The Hundred Private Eyes”? And these are assorted collections for “The Flavor of Flounder” and “Mololo From Across The Street”.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, they had all these...?
I searched for ages, and I didn't see them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That may be because they're not on the same shelf as the reference guides. I might actually bring this matter up during our next committee meeting...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks for getting these for me...
I'm on the library committee now too, for crying out loud. I feel so embarrassed about not being able to find these...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You just joined, so I wouldn't worry too much about that. You still have plenty of time to learn where everything is.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks...
By the way, Aoyagi, has your class decided what to do for the festival?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be performing a dance routine. Akiyama and I are both in charge of making the costumes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I've never really sewed anything before...
But my classmates have been teaching me as I go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That reminds me. They gave me some tips on how to tie thread knots. I'm still practicing, but I should be able to master it soon.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's great.
Best of luck with your prep, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Let's make the festival a good one.
A few days later
Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wow, the books Aoyagi found for me have helped so much. I have a somewhat better idea of what I want our film to be like now...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I still need to come up with the actual story and the characters. I'm leaning towards making the protagonist some sort of wanderer... I also need to come up with some enemies, and a reason to fight them...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(This is really hard.
I don't have experience coming up with stories that involve lots of action.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Plus, I have to try to include as many of the others' ideas as I can.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's see... What did they all say again...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
A tearjerker, something sci-fi...
Oh, an ad for her family's restaurant... I probably shouldn't consider that one.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The list goes on, but I'll need to think about them carefully since I probably can't include them all.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I didn't realize coming up with a story from scratch would be this difficult. I should've helped Tsukasa and the others more when they were writing theirs...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I might not be able to do this all on my own...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I think I'll head over to SEKAI. I'm not gonna come up with any good ideas while feeling stuck inside my room...)
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Uhh... Where is everyone...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I can't wait to see how Tsukasa and Rui's class play turns out.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What are you all talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene!
Hiya☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We were just talking about the arts festival your guys' school is about to hold!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Tsukasa and Rui told us their class is gonna be doing a play. So, Nene, what's your class doing?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, okay. I didn't realize they already told you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
My class is making a film.
Which is giving me some trouble...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wow. With you as the director...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Cool!
That means you get to make all the decisions and stuff, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You're in charge of bringing everyone's ideas together and leading them in the right direction...
That's so wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah, it is☆
You've got a good head on those shoulders, Nene, so I'm sure you'll do an amazing job as the director!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You think so...?
I haven't been doing so well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I mean, when we were coming up with ideas for our film the other day...

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: Wait, can't we just do all of them?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Things got really out of hand, which made me wonder how I'm going to do as the director...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I see. That must've been very challenging...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: To be fair, there isn't much I can do since me and the others in my class have exactly opposite personalities...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Opposite personalities...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, um... Most of them have really cheerful personalities. And they're so outgoing... Basically everything that I'm not.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I feel this sort of wall between us since I don't really know how to deal with them...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is there anything we can do about that?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
What you just said is bothering me a little, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. She feels that there's a wall between her and them because she's the opposite kind of person!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I don't know what they're like...
But I don't think personalities have anything to do with this wall you're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You, Tsukasa, Emu and Rui all have really different personalities, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But you're all such good friends. There's no wall between you and them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess you're right.
Hinomori told me something similar too...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But I do shows with them...
I don't really have anything in common like that with my classmates...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree with what Len's saying...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I also see your point in terms of commonalities. Yes, you do shows with the others.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But that makes me wonder how you were able to become friends with Tsukasa and Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's a good question...
I guess by doing shows together...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's right!
Sometimes, people form bonds and friendships with one another before they have a chance to think about it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I don't think shows are the real reason why you were able to become friends with them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I believe it's because you got to know them better after spending time with them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Because I got to know them...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When I first met them, I thought they were way too eccentric for their own good...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it didn't take long for me to realize that they both had dreams they were working hard to make come true...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Before I knew it, that wall between us started crumbling away.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which tells me that your classmates should be no different...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, your classmates are probably just like Tsukasa and Emu!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
They all have their hopes and dreams...
They all like this and that, have their share of troubles and feel a variety of emotions...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I bet that wall you were talking about will disappear in no time after you get to know them better!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You might be right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone.
I think I have a little better idea of what I need to do now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
Can I ask you guys about something else?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sure, what?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'm supposed to write the screenplay for our movie, but I'm having trouble coming up with good ideas...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What?! You're writing the screenplay?!
That sounds really fun!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I've written everything down in this notebook, including all of my classmates' ideas.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was hoping that you could all help me come up with a good story...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, of course! Can you show us your notebook?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wow, so many ideas...
Oh, you've decided on an action film?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! Action?! That means...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Your main character's gotta be cool and strong!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A hero who helps those in need and fights to protect them... A hero who doesn't give up! Even when fighting against a really tough opponent!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I really love those kinds of stories!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Really...?
I didn't know that, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yup!
This manga Tsukasa lent me recently was like that. It was so cool!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Then, the protagonist needs to be cool like that...
After that, all you have to do is start mixing in all your classmates' ideas, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You have “sci-fi” and “an ad for her family's restaurant” written here. Your story could take place far in the future... And the hero could be a cook! Who fights!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: W-Wait, a cook...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds fun!
Then, the enemies could also be cooks, and...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I-I'm not sure how to feel about this...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But with their help, I might be able to get a synopsis ready by tomorrow...)
